info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Event History Management API
info.description: The Servicing Event History Management API enables businesses to update and manage the historical servicing events for banking interactions across different channels. This API allows for patching of specific event records, ensuring all relevant details are current and aligned with operational requirements. Typical consumers include financial institutions looking to maintain accurate records of customer service interactions and ensure compliance. Use cases might involve correcting records after customer inquiries or updates following service interactions.
